definition: Restoring the short-vowel and gemination marks (حَرَكات) that written Arabic omits.
details: Restoring the short-vowel and gemination marks (حَرَكات) that written Arabic omits. Undiacritized words are massively ambiguous (علم: knowledge / flag / he-taught / it-was-known), making diacritization a task in itself and a critical front-end for TTS, where wrong diacritics mean wrong pronunciation.
